topic: DPoP htu mismatch on token endpoint

messages.text: Partner getting invalid_dpop_proof only in staging, prod fine. Any idea?
Check `htu` — must be the exact token endpoint URL from the discovery doc for that environment.
They hardcoded the prod URL in the DPoP builder 🤦
Yep. Tell them to read endpoints from `.well-known/openid-configuration` per env.

outcome: Partner fixed `htu` by reading endpoints from OpenID discovery per environment.

messages.text: Partner sets client assertion exp = iat + 1 hour. Token call fails invalid_client.
Assertion must be short-lived — see Generation of Client Assertion for exp limits. Also aud must be the issuer.
Shared the doc. They'll set a ~2 min expiry.

outcome: Short-lived assertion with correct `aud` resolved invalid_client.

topic: Spike of empty CPF fields on Sunday

messages.text: Several agencies report empty CPF data this morning.
Will reply with the scheduled downtime page link.

outcome: Classified as scheduled downtime, not an incident.

messages.text: Bank app asking how to keep deep-linking without custom scheme.
Universal Links / App Links with https redirect URLs. Custom schemes are dropped in FAPI 2.0.

outcome: Partner moved to app-claimed https URLs.

messages.text: Partner added a new key but still failing — how long do we cache JWKS?
Tell them to keep publishing both old and new keys during rotation and not to reuse kids. See Key Rotation section.

outcome: Advised overlap period during key rotation.

messages.text: Partner wants a second app with same config for another product line.
SDP has 'Duplicate an app' — cheaper than recreating, but redirect URLs/scopes still need review.
